[[File:ProfitSmasher.jpg|thumb]]
The '''''ProfitSmasher''''' was a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]]. When its crew failed to make loan payments to [[Brebu]], his underlings shot down the ship. It crashed on a backwater world. The entire crew perished or were taken as [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] by Brebu. Many criminals tried, without success, to turn the wreck into a base. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Brebu himself decided to make it his base.<ref name="Hideouts & Strongholds">''[[Hideouts & Strongholds]]''</ref>
